APPN.physical_anchor: None — cloud low-code business-process-automation software; no physical product manufactured or moved.
APPN.value_chain_position: Enterprise low-code/BPM SaaS platform sold as subscriptions; not a chain constituent.

APPS.physical_anchor: None — mobile app-delivery and ad-tech software embedded on OEM Android devices; no physical product.
APPS.value_chain_position: On-device mobile app marketing/monetization software platform; ad-tech, not a physical chain.

ARQQ.physical_anchor: No revenue-generating physical anchor — core product is post-quantum symmetric-key-agreement encryption SOFTWARE; satellite-based QKD hardware is roadmap-stage, not commercialized, and the company markets itself as explicitly NOT requiring quantum hardware.
ARQQ.value_chain_position: Post-quantum cryptography software vendor (QuantumCloud); a software encryption company, not a qubit-hardware or QKD-hardware constituent.

ARXS.physical_anchor: Manufactures precision electronic and mechanical components — RF/microwave parts, connectors, cable assemblies, sensors, precision bearings — for extreme-environment systems.
ARXS.value_chain_position: Diversified precision-component supplier (connectors, RF/microwave hardware, sensors, bearings) across defense, space, medical-device and semiconductor-test end markets; no dated nuclear/grid/quantum contract concentration — industry-filter false positive via Aerospace & Defense.

ASAN.physical_anchor: None — cloud work-management/collaboration SaaS; no physical product.
ASAN.value_chain_position: Enterprise work-management/collaboration software sold as subscriptions; not a chain constituent.

ASTE.physical_anchor: Manufactures road-building and materials-processing equipment — asphalt plants, aggregate crushing/screening systems, mobile pavers.
ASTE.value_chain_position: Heavy-equipment OEM for road construction and aggregate/asphalt processing — an infrastructure-capex cyclical, not a grid/nuclear/power/robotics chain constituent; industry-filter false positive on generic 'Industrial - Machinery'.

ASYS.physical_anchor: Manufactures thermal-processing equipment (diffusion furnaces) for semiconductor and power/SiC device fabrication.
ASYS.value_chain_position: Semiconductor-fab capital-equipment maker (furnaces/wafer-processing tools) serving broad chip and power-device manufacturing — not specifically tied to quantum-hardware production.

ATEC.physical_anchor: Manufactures spinal implants, screws/rods and surgical instrumentation for spine surgery; no proprietary surgical-robot platform.
ATEC.value_chain_position: Spine-focused medical-device maker (implants plus navigation/imaging via EOS); adjacent to but not itself a surgical-robotics platform.

ATKR.physical_anchor: Manufactures electrical conduit, armored cable, wire and cable-management products for electrical construction and utility infrastructure.
ATKR.value_chain_position: Electrical-infrastructure toll-taker — conduit, cable and cable-management for grid, datacenter and construction electrical build-out (power management & connectors layer).

ATOM.physical_anchor: No physical product of its own — licenses Mears Silicon Technology (MST) material-engineering IP to chipmakers; does not fabricate.
ATOM.value_chain_position: Semiconductor IP licensor (transistor-performance material technology); a pre-scale licensing business, not a chain physical anchor.

AVAV.physical_anchor: Manufactures unmanned aircraft systems (drones), loitering munitions and space/cyber systems (BlueHalo) for defense customers.
AVAV.value_chain_position: Defense UAS/space-systems manufacturer — real physical hardware, but a defense-procurement business, not a commercial grid/nuclear/robotics-automation/quantum chain constituent; industry-filter false positive via Aerospace & Defense.

AVEX.physical_anchor: Designs and builds autonomous uncrewed aerial vehicles and unmanned surface vessels plus ISR mission-support services for defense/intelligence customers.
AVEX.value_chain_position: Defense ISR/tactical-autonomy hardware and services provider — physical uncrewed platforms, but a defense-ISR business, not a commercial robotics_automation constituent (factory/warehouse/surgical/humanoid thesis).

AVR.physical_anchor: Manufactures a transcatheter aortic heart-valve device (DurAVR).
AVR.value_chain_position: Structural-heart medical-device developer/manufacturer; a cardiac-device company, not a robotics or FDT-chain constituent — industry-filter false positive via Medical - Devices.

AVTR.physical_anchor: Manufactures and distributes lab chemicals, reagents, consumables and lab equipment for biopharma/research customers.
AVTR.value_chain_position: Life-sciences materials and lab-supply distributor/manufacturer; not a robotics/automation or FDT-chain company.

AXGN.physical_anchor: Manufactures peripheral-nerve-repair biologic grafts and matrices.
AXGN.value_chain_position: Nerve-repair biologics maker; a medical-device/biologics company, not a robotics or FDT-chain constituent.

AXIA.physical_anchor: Owns and operates 44 hydroelectric plants plus nuclear, thermal and wind/solar generation, and roughly 66,500 km of transmission lines across Brazil (formerly Centrais Elétricas Brasileiras / Eletrobrás).
AXIA.value_chain_position: Diversified Brazilian state-linked generation-and-transmission utility running conventional large nuclear (Angra) and hydro, not SMRs or a US AI-datacenter PPA book — does not ride nuclear_smr's dated-milestone thesis or power_for_ai's datacenter-scarcity thesis.

AXON.physical_anchor: Manufactures conducted-energy weapons (TASER) and body-worn/in-car cameras; also fields public-safety drones (Axon Air).
AXON.value_chain_position: Public-safety hardware and digital-evidence-management software (TASER, cameras, cloud); a law-enforcement technology company, not a grid/nuclear/FDT-chain constituent — industry-filter false positive via Aerospace & Defense.

AXTI.physical_anchor: Manufactures compound-semiconductor substrate wafers (indium phosphide, gallium arsenide, germanium) via proprietary vertical-gradient-freeze crystal growth.
AXTI.value_chain_position: Upstream compound-semiconductor substrate producer (InP/GaAs/Ge wafers) feeding photonic-integrated-circuit, silicon-photonics and laser makers (photonics & lasers layer) as well as LiDAR/industrial-robotics sensor makers — a materials toll-taker one to two steps back from both chains, but revenue is diversified across 5G/datacenter-optics/solar rather than concentrated on quantum or robotics specifically.

AZTA.physical_anchor: Operates automated cold-chain sample-storage/biobanking systems and provides genomics sequencing services (GENEWIZ); its former semiconductor-automation unit was divested.
AZTA.value_chain_position: Life-sciences sample-management (automated biobanking/cold storage) and genomics-services provider; not a robotics_automation-chain company.

BA.physical_anchor: Manufactures commercial and military aircraft, satellites and defense systems.
BA.value_chain_position: Diversified commercial/defense aerospace OEM; a legacy industrial giant, not a chain constituent — industry-filter false positive via Aerospace & Defense.
